purpose: SOP 2 - base software, drivers, firmware and runtime versions present on the board

collection.method: read-only shell collection; no installation, no compilation, no inference or performance verification

field_status_legend.system_report: value reported by the running operating system
field_status_legend.tool_report: value reported by the vendor toolchain
field_status_legend.measured: value observed on site during this collection
field_status_legend.unverified: not cross-checked against a second source
field_status_legend.not_supported: the platform does not expose the field at all
field_status_legend.not_accessible: the field exists but could not be read with the privileges used

python.note: there is no 'python' alias on this board; use python3 explicitly

packages.numpy_note: numpy 1.23.0 is the last release that supports Python 3.8

python_packages.note: pip list was truncated to the first 80 lines by the collection command; the list above is the complete set of pip-visible packages in the system site-packages plus the vendor icraft package, and the full captured listing is in raw_logs/pip.txt

kernel_toolchain.value: gcc 7.5.0 (Linaro GCC 7.5-2019.12) - used to build the running kernel, distinct from the userspace gcc 9.4.0

icraft_cli.note: the CLI build stamp embeds 2608220046, i.e. a 2026-08-22 build

icraft_usage.note: 'icraft device list' is not a valid subcommand and aborts with a toml-not-found stack trace. The CLI expects a config.toml; a real device probe needs a valid config, which was deliberately not created (SOP 2 collects state, it does not run inference).

npu_runtime_stack.note: the full ZG330 userspace stack is installed even though the NPU exposes no dedicated /dev node

interpretation.value: libicraft_zg330backend.so + libsocketzg330aiu.so + libaxizg330aiu.so are the ZG330 accelerator backend and its AXI transport; libmockzg330.so is a mock backend. The presence of a real ZG330 backend alongside a mock one is consistent with a board that carries the NPU toolchain.
interpretation.caution: library presence is not evidence that a model can be executed on the NPU. No inference was run (SOP 2 forbids it).

tflite_runtime.note: CPU reference runtime installed as a pip package
